podcast.title: Death at Age 36
podcast.body: Georgiana Tillman died in 1980 at the young age of 36, a consequence of the autoimmune disease lupus, which at the time was often a death sentence, though largely treatable now. Her early passing highlights the severe health challenges she faced. "She died in 1980, aged only 36."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Exclusion from Motown Anniversaries
podcast.body: Despite her foundational role in Motown's first number one group, Georgiana Tillman was not invited to any of the label's significant anniversary celebrations. "None of the members of the first group to hit number one on the label were invited to be part of any of them."

podcast.title: Health Struggles and Early Retirement
podcast.body: Georgiana Tillman suffered from sickle cell anemia since childhood, and the relentless touring schedule severely exacerbated her health, leading to a later diagnosis of lupus. The toll on her body forced her to retire from music, after which she worked as a secretary for Motown. "She'd been diagnosed with sickle cell anemia as a child, and the constant strain of touring made her more ill."
